verdict.rationale: Better Stack documents a REST API with bearer-token auth. A global API token is described as valid "for managing anything within Better Stack", and the docs show full CRUD (POST/PATCH/DELETE) on monitors with per-endpoint references and Terraform support. API coverage is only evidenced for monitors, and no OpenAPI spec was found at any probed path. missing for 10: explicit UI/API parity statement, evidenced API coverage for status pages, on-call schedules, escalation policies and incidents, machine-readable OpenAPI spec, independent corroboration.
